chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Speak so that you may be known, since man is hidden under his tongue.
ai.seo_question: How does speech reveal a person's true character according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises that speech reveals a person's true character and inner self, a concept deeply rooted in Shia hermeneutics where the tongue is viewed as the primary instrument of self-disclosure. This saying underscores the practical implication that one's eloquence and choice of words serve as a mirror to their hidden virtues or flaws, a theme echoed in the Quranic warning that 'every man's tongue will testify against him' on the Day of Judgment.
